hook: HYDRAA fences *₹70 crore* of park land in Khajaguda
hook_b: HYDRAA fences *₹70 crore* of park land in Khajaguda
tldr: HYDRAA fenced 3,500 sq yards of park land in Khajaguda on Nov 25 after local complaints and declared it government land.

beats.what: Officials inspected the site after local complaints, fenced it and declared it government land.
beats.why: The layout's open space was split across two spots; a temple stands on 700 sq yards.
beats.care: Another 1,000 sq yards of the open space is in an encroachment dispute pending in court.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The land is valued at around ₹70 crore, Siasat reported.

cards.q: Does your colony's layout park still exist as open space?

qs: Who will develop and maintain the fenced land as a park?

viz.note: 700 sq yd temple; 1,000 sq yd in court
viz.verdict: Most of the layout's open space is now fenced as government land.

watch: The court ruling on the disputed 1,000 sq yards of open space.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: HYDRAA protects park land worth Rs 70 crore in Khajaguda

fact: HYDRAA fenced *3,500 sq yards* of Khajaguda park land worth ₹70 crore
twist: The 25-acre, 262-plot layout had kept only *5,870 sq yards* as open space.
